descriptions: Before the patch, devlink_nl_port_get_dump_one() constructed port dump replies by calling devlink_nl_port_fill() with the generic DEVLINK_CMD_NEW command value, so consumers of the generated netlink message observed a command type inconsistent with port-get responses and port notifications. After the patch, the same sink is called with DEVLINK_CMD_PORT_NEW, replacing the wrong protocol constant with the port-specific command value.
